decision.reason: [ev-4a489b1e9ff3] only says that the `tracing.datadog.globaltag` option "has been removed" in v3. It does not say what happens when the option is still configured. Traefik could silently ignore the key or reject it when loading the configuration. The proposed statement that the option "is ignored and has no effect" is therefore a guess, not something the evidence shows. To decide the consequence kind, we need evidence on how Traefik v3 handles this removed key when it is still set, such as the static or dynamic configuration loader's behaviour or a migration-guide note on unknown options.
